scripts.dev: bunx concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "bun run dev:server" "bun run dev:client"
scripts.dev:server: bun run --cwd server sh -c 'cd .. && set -a && . ./.env.local && set +a && cd server && exec go run ./cmd/marquee'
scripts.build: bun run build:client && bun run build:server
scripts.build:client: bun run --cwd client build && rm -rf server/internal/web/dist && cp -r client/dist server/internal/web/dist
